chunks: And ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj narrated from him, peace be upon him:

Regarding a man who entered iḥrām in one month and exited iḥrām in another, he said: "It will be written for him according to what he intended." And he said: "It will be written for him according to the better of them."

key_terms.أَفْضَلِهَا: the more virtuous of the two months
key_terms.شَهْرٍ: a month, referring to the time of the rite

ai.seo_question: If someone enters iḥrām in one month and completes ʿumrah in another, which month is the reward counted for?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a person whose ʿumrah spans two different months. The reward is tied to intention, and it is also counted according to the more virtuous of the two months.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2950 - It was narrated from Abdul-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding a man who enters Ihram in one month and exits Ihram in another month.

Imam (as) said: "He will be rewarded according to his intention."
And Imam (as) also said: "He will be rewarded for the better of the two months."
